name: Jamahal Hill

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (76 in height, 79 in reach, southpaw, born 1991-05-19); 206 lb at the UFC Baku weigh-in on 2025-06-20, his last fight (decision loss to Khalil Rountree Jr.). Press reports from June-August 2026 say he has put on weight and plans a heavyweight debut; no photos of the heavier version were found.

photo_coverage: Fair to good, but none free. 8 photos, all from 2025 or earlier: a sharp 2025 frontal studio headshot, two full-body studio cutouts and a high-resolution waist-up studio portrait (all 2025), a three-quarter post-fight photo (UFC 311, January 2025, with temporary swelling), a large near-frontal press close-up (date unknown), an action shot and a weigh-in. Nothing from 2026: he has not fought since June 2025. Wikimedia Commons has no photo of him, so there is no embed-ok image. No true side profile was found.

face.shape: Long oval face, fairly narrow across the cheekbones, tapering to a medium chin; tall forehead.
face.jaw: Lean and angular, moderately narrow, with a clean jawline under sparse stubble.
face.chin: Medium width, slightly pointed, moderately projecting, with a sparse chin beard.
face.cheekbones: Moderately prominent, set high; cheeks lean and slightly hollow below.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; brows sit low over the eyes.
face.forehead: Tall and broad, gently rounded; a few small raised marks or bumps on the forehead (2025 headshot).

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped with slightly heavy upper lids; outer corners level.

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low, slightly thicker at the inner ends, with a mild downward pull toward the centre that gives a steady, serious look.

nose.width: Medium-broad at the base, narrower at the bridge

mouth.upper_lip: Full with a defined cupid's bow and philtrum; thin moustache above
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, neutral to slightly pursed; deep nasolabial lines frame the mouth.

ears.protrusion: Moderately out from the head, more at the top.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No obvious cauliflower ear in the studio portrait or close-up.
ears.accessory: Small stud earring in the left lobe (2025 studio portrait).

face.notable_marks_scars: A few small raised marks on the forehead; no large facial scars. The UFC 311 post-fight swelling and cuts around the eyes are temporary.

hair.style: Short natural crop about 1-1.5 cm on top, slightly shorter at the sides, neatly edged.
hair.hairline: Fairly straight across the front with rounded corners and mild recession at the temples; neatly lined.

facial_hair.detail: Thin, trimmed moustache plus a sparse chin beard (goatee) that thins into light stubble along the jaw toward the ears; cheeks clean. About 3-5 mm long.
facial_hair.density: Moustache medium; chin beard sparse to medium; jaw stubble light and patchy.
facial_hair.shape: Pencil moustache over a short, rounded chin patch, loosely connected along the jaw.

skin.tone_hex_method: Mean of the 8 headshot, studio, press and cutout samples that are not highlights (9x9-pixel medians), excluding the studio highlights and the abdomen.
skin.tone_note: Medium-deep brown. The bright Getty studio portrait reads lighter and the ESPN grade redder; the recommended value averages one lit and one shadow cheek from the press close-up, the cutout chest, one Getty cheek and both headshot cheeks, which matches how he looks across the set. He is clearly darker than Ulberg and Reyes.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles. Light chest and body hair; small forehead marks noted above.
skin.texture_pick_reason: Nearest swatch by colour distance (#875d4b vs recommended #a85e46); tint slightly lighter and warmer.

body.build: Tall and long-limbed with a lean, rangy frame; reach 79 in, 3 in more than his height, with long legs.
body.body_fat_notes: Smooth at light heavyweight: little ab definition and a soft, rounded lower belly in all 2025 studio photos, even at fight weight; leaner and more defined when flexing at weigh-ins. Reported to be heavier in 2026 for a heavyweight move (no photos).
body.shoulders: Moderately broad, sloping slightly, with rounded deltoids.
body.arms: Long and lean; moderate biceps, long forearms.
body.waist: Moderate, softer at the lower belly; only a mild V-taper.
body.legs_calves: Long legs, lean thighs, slim calves and long feet.
body.posture: Relaxed and upright with a slight forward head carriage and arms hanging close to the body. Fights southpaw (right foot forward); throws the rear left leg to the body (Baku 2025).
body.notable_physique_traits: Chest tattoo 'Northsides' between two thumbs-up hands; long limbs; soft lower belly.

tattoos.where: Upper chest, centred below the collarbones
tattoos.description: Black cursive/Old-English script reading 'Northsides' (a flourish on the first letter).

tattoos.where: Right upper chest (his right pec, below the collarbone)
tattoos.description: Black outline of a thumbs-up fist with grey-shaded curled fingers: wrist toward the shoulder, knuckles and the raised thumb toward the centre, so the hand points at the script.

tattoos.where: Left upper chest (his left pec, below the collarbone)
tattoos.description: Matching thumbs-up fist, mirror image of the right one (wrist toward the left shoulder, thumb toward the centre).

tattoos.where: Right outer upper arm, below the deltoid
tattoos.description: Black numerals that read '722'; the first character is thin and faded and could be a stylised slash.

tattoos.where: Left outer upper arm, near the deltoid
tattoos.description: Black cursive script beginning 'Ma...'; the rest wraps around the arm and was not legible in any photo.
Black tribal-style lion head in profile.

tattoos_note: No tattoos visible on the abdomen, forearms or legs. His back is not clearly shown.
accessories_seen: Stud earring in the left ear (2025).

kit.typical_shorts: Black UFC/Venum shorts with grey 'tiger-stripe' patterns, both board-short (2025 Baku cutout) and compression (2025 UFC 311 cutout) cuts; black Venum shorts at UFC Baku.

render_hints.hair: short natural crop about 1.2 cm (mh-hair-short02 scaled down, or a scalp tint #1d1517 with a lined-up front edge)
render_hints.beard: thin moustache plus sparse chin goatee, #1a1213, light stubble along the jaw

morphs_variant_heavyweight_2026._note: UNVERIFIED: no photos of the 2026 heavier version. Press says he added weight to move to heavyweight. Apply on top of 'morphs' only if the sim uses a 2026 heavyweight Hill.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Ears are medium with slight protrusion at the top, so no ear morphs are needed.

notes: Confidence: high for skin range, hair, facial hair, tattoos and build; medium for face proportions (sharp 2025 frontals and a large close-up, three-quarters only with fight damage, no profile); low-to-medium for exact morph values. No embed-ok photos exist on Commons. Watch for: (1) A long, narrow oval face with high cheekbones, lean cheeks and an angular jaw; avoid a broad or round head. (2) Thin pencil moustache and a sparse chin goatee, not a full beard. (3) Low, straight black brows; almond, slightly heavy-lidded dark eyes; medium-broad nose with a rounded tip; full lips with a defined cupid's bow. (4) Short natural crop with a neat, lined front edge. (5) Medium-deep warm brown skin (darker than Ulberg's). (6) The chest set ('Northsides' between two thumbs-up hands) is the signature tattoo; add '722' on the right upper arm, script on the left upper arm, lion on the right foot. (7) Long and rangy with a soft lower belly at 205; southpaw. macro/ageOldM 0.154 follows avatar3d.js (35-25)/65; heightUpM 0.32 matches the other 193 cm sheets; proportionsUpM 0.6 reflects the long limbs.
